minutes.headline: Selectmen made a seven-member design committee for the TC Passios building, with a School Committee seat and Damon as the board's rep.
minutes.summary: The board ratified several police appointments, heard the Council on Aging annual update, and got a Town Manager report that included final state aid figures. Most of the meeting went to forming a building committee for the TC Passios consolidated-use design, with sharp disagreement over its size, a school seat, and whether an opponent should sit on it. The board also approved a new vote tabulator, reviewed its policy manual, and went into executive session about the Conservation Commission chairman.

public_comment.topic: Announcement of Lions Club pancake breakfast at the Senior Center the next morning.

Asked for clarification of public comment policy and urged openness; said he wants full cost of the whole package of town buildings before voting, and raised concern about school impact of Arrow's Farm development.

votes.motion: Ratify town manager's appointment of two police sergeants, effective August 13 and 14.
Ratify appointments of two full-time police officers effective November 2 and 3.
Ratify appointment of reserve police officer Anthony Cappucci.
Create building committee per the bylaw with the seventh seat offered to the School Committee rather than Finance Committee (later amended so one board seat goes to Finance Committee designee).
votes.outcome: passed (voice vote with one nay and one abstention; exact count not audible)

votes.motion: Designate Damon as the Board of Selectmen's representative on the building committee.
Replace the Accu-Vote optical scan tabulator with the new ICP tabulator.
Accept the July 2019 revised recycle policy replacing the 2001 one.
Amend policy manual section 1.1 public comment as written, with a hold to revisit it.
Accept deletion of smoking language in section 2.05 as moved to employee handbook.
Enter executive session under chapter 30A section 21 reason one concerning the Conservation Commission chairman, not to return to open session.

what_happened.line: The Select Board voted to create a seven-member building committee for the TC Passios design, with one seat offered to the School Committee.
The board agreed to follow the bylaw's committee makeup and keep it at seven members rather than nine.
The board named Damon as its representative on the building committee.
The town manager is to notify the Planning Board and School Committee so they can name designees, and to advertise for three citizen-at-large members.
The board ratified three sets of police appointments: two sergeants, two full-time officers and one reserve officer.

why_it_matters: The TC Passios building committee will shape the design of a project that residents will likely be asked to fund, and its makeup decides which boards and citizens have a voice in it.
A public speaker asked to see the full cost of the whole package of town buildings before any vote, so the total commitment may become a question for residents at a later vote.
watch_next: Appointment of the Planning Board and School Committee designees, and the advertisement for three citizen-at-large seats on the building committee.
The social media policy, tabled for members to read the Easton model and expected back, likely in September.
